physics_report.object_state_assignment: reset only; actuator commands only during all physics steps

interaction.derived_from: source gripper command, interpreted by the verified source adapter
interaction.limitation: one active rigid object and right gripper; other modes require explicit adapters

task_contract.frame: source world before rigid scene placement

plan.trajectory_seed: existing kinematic retarget; no approach, release, base or timing replanning

pad_alignment.pad_definition: area-weighted inward distal collision faces, proxy checked against source visual insert
pad_alignment.gripper_policy: source commands unchanged; inferred aperture is calibration only

previous_pad_alignment.pad_definition: area-weighted inward distal collision faces, proxy checked against source visual insert
previous_pad_alignment.gripper_policy: source commands unchanged; inferred aperture is calibration only

shape_eligibility.selection: Smallest original collision box containing the native grasp point

grasp_attachment.scope: One constant robot TCP attachment; complete original clock, object references and geometry retained

grasp_roll.scope: One constant robot TCP attachment; both calibrated pad-point world paths, complete source clock, object references, geometry and contact intent retained

robot_initialization.method: Warm-start full path backward/forward from geometry-derived feasible manipulation anchor; SLSQP exact TCP objective +1e-8 previous-solution displacement penalty; all original torso bars constrained3mm from fixed source table

solver.method: Warm-start full path backward/forward from geometry-derived feasible manipulation anchor; SLSQP exact TCP objective +1e-8 previous-solution displacement penalty; all original torso bars constrained3mm from fixed source table
solver.derived_robot_hand_targets: Constant10degree rotation about original calibrated pad line; both pad trajectories unchanged

finite_pad_projected_support.scope: Projection of actual finite CAD face triangles onto the unchanged selected40mm-square component face; triangle-square polygon clipping, not a claimed physical pressure patch

plan.closed_command_semantics: Original negative values are contact intent; actual motor target is recorded separately

robot_fixture_clearance.scope: All compiled physical robot/fixture collision pairs; selected active-object subtrees and only explicit support pairs excluded
robot_fixture_clearance.fixture_pose_scope: Original compiled reset with source passive fixture initialization; no object trajectory or physics stepping
robot_fixture_clearance.aperture_scope: Five-point closed aperture envelopes and opening/closing transitions; continuous swept-volume clearance is not asserted

component.selection: Smallest original collision box containing the native grasp point

box_acquisition.clock_policy: Repeat acquisition index during entry/settle/close; consume every exit_source_indices row exactly once, then the unchanged original suffix
box_acquisition.ff_policy: Zero velocity feedforward during entry/settle/close/exit; original controller elsewhere
box_acquisition.guard_scope: Saved calibrated-aperture CAD at measured TCP forecasts closing patch; current-aperture midpoint is additionally checked near contact; actual object pose is read only

finite_projected_support.scope: Exact projected CAD triangle overlap; not a measured contact-pressure area

torso.calibration: URDF nominal extrinsics; no fitted lens/mount calibration asserted

left_head.calibration: URDF nominal extrinsics; no fitted lens/mount calibration asserted

right_head.calibration: URDF nominal extrinsics; no fitted lens/mount calibration asserted

assumptions: Robot-only gravity compensation; object gravity remains enabled
Planar ideal base servos; wheels locked
Manufacturer collision meshes used as convex hulls
Finger gains kp=8 kv=.8 torque limit=2 Nm; arm kp=180 kv=24 limit=40 Nm
Unspecified robot/environment friction=1,.01,.001; source Can friction retained
physics.source_material_contact_policy: Source-compiled physical fields explicitly resolved before merging; source body mass/inertia retained; robot-only defaults cannot alter source bodies
physics.object_state_assignment: initial XML pose only; dynamic free joint for every subsequent physics step
simulation_assumptions: Source-derived simulator properties are not measured real-object properties
MuJoCo version and robot servo settings may differ from source collection runtime
Object velocities start at zero at reset; only the recorded initial object poses are transplanted
Missing textures affect appearance only and are enumerated; collision meshes are mandatory

acquisition_execution.source_clock_semantics: Pause command progression during settle/close; never alter the integration clock or source samples
acquisition_execution.clock_scope: Source rows are retained; entry and measured waits repeat the acquisition index. Physical time must advance at every frame.

actuator_audit.meaning: Control replay equivalence; task and contact success remain separate recorded gates

acquisition_guard_audit.scope: Every executed original reference index/intent/clock verified, pauses replayed from measured guards, and guards independently recomputed in actuator-only physics
